rationale: C13 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template: both orders place territory into an internal revenue collection district using the same operative construction, "transferred/attached to and made a part of," and both set January 1, 1951 as the effective date. C03 shares the Virgin Islands setting and jurisdictional-transfer concepts but concerns federal property rather than revenue-district organization. C16 concerns internal revenue administration but uses materially different machinery.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the Virgin Islands be attached to and made a part of the internal revenue collection district of Maryland
shared_material.parent_excerpt: is transferred to and made a part of the second internal revenue collection district of New York
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive parallel operative language applies the same administrative mechanism—incorporating specified territory into an internal revenue collection district—to a new geographic target.

shared_material.child_excerpt: This order shall be effective as of January 1, 1951.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: This order shall become effective on January 1, 1951.
shared_material.explanation: The orders use nearly identical effectiveness clauses and specify the same effective date.
